title: 第九章进入死亡森林哀山第十章通灵神玉
content_zh:
龙城，哀山外！！
秦风像是丧家之犬般倒在地上，身体抽搐，右拳不断砸在地面上，发出闷哼之响。
哪怕已然出血，但却像是感受不到疼痛一样！！
“不！！”
“为什么！！”
“为什么要救我？”
“为什么要牺牲自己！！”
“龙野爷爷！！”
“我....我对不起您！！”
“都是我，才害死您！！”
“啊！！！”
秦风泪流满脸，发出无比痛苦的声音和咆哮声。
远处，已经有龙城修士和龙家高层听到了声音，正朝着秦风所在的方向赶了过来。
而秦风还沉浸在痛苦与悲伤之中，像是被抽了魂一样，似乎已经不打算活下去了。
就在此时，秦风胸前的玉佩再次亮起了细微白光，耳边也响起了一道从未听过的声音。
“主人，快走！”
“以你现在的实力，无法对付那些追击而来的人。”
“先逃走再说，难道，你想让那个老头为你白死吗？？”
闻言此话，秦风先是一愣，但很快就回过神来，左看右看后，这才低头看向胸前闪着微弱白光的玉佩道：“是.....是你在和我说话？？”
“没错！就是我，主人。”

“来不及解释了。”
“快进入你前方的森林里，否则，必死无疑！！”
“快！！”
听到这样催促且担心自己的声音，秦风本来有很多话想问，但却一时之间全都忘了，然后又响起了龙野爷爷临死前说的那些话。
顿时，秦风站起身来，擦拭嘴角已然干涸的鲜血后，一边超前奔跑，一边呢喃道：“对，我不能死，我要死了，龙野爷爷肯定会怪我！！”
“为了龙野爷爷，我一定要活下去！”
“我还有九龙至尊诀没有修炼，我还有九龙至尊鼎没有使用！！”
“我一定能够变强，一定！！”
“我要报仇！！”
“我要活下去！！”
“我要让龙城龙家，灰飞烟灭！！！”
“啊！！！”
在愤怒的支撑，秦风爆发出了体内潜能，再次施展身法《游龙》，以极快速度，消失在了原地，进入了哀山之中。
没过多久。
咻咻咻~
一道道修士身影从天而降，落在了秦风刚才所在的地方。
看着眼前残留的血迹，以及秦风用拳头所砸出来的拳坑时，龙战眉头一簇道：“这小子，居然还有此等体力？难道本族长先前的龙象拳威，真的没有对他造成太大伤害么？”
content_en:
Dragon City, outside Aishan Mountain! !
Qin Feng fell to the ground like a bereaved dog, his body twitched, and his right fist kept hitting the ground, making a muffled sound.
Even though he was bleeding, it seemed like he couldn't feel the pain! !
"No!!"
"Why!!"
"Why did you save me?"
"Why sacrifice yourself!!"
"Grandpa Tatsuno!!"
"I...I'm sorry for you!!"
"It's only me who killed you!!"
"Ah!!!"
Qin Feng's face was filled with tears, and he made sounds and roars of great pain.
In the distance, Longcheng monks and senior officials of the Long family heard the sound and rushed towards Qin Feng's direction.
Qin Feng was still immersed in pain and sadness, as if his soul had been sucked out, and he seemed to have no intention of living anymore.
At this moment, the jade pendant on Qin Feng's chest once again lit up with a subtle white light, and a sound he had never heard before sounded in his ears.
"Master, leave quickly!"
"With your current strength, you cannot deal with those who are chasing you."
"Escape first. Do you want that old man to die for you in vain?"
Hearing these words, Qin Feng was stunned for a moment, but soon came to his senses. After looking left and right, he looked down at the jade pendant with a faint white light on his chest and said, "Yes... you are talking to me?"
"That's right! It's me, Master."
"It's too late to explain."
"Hurry into the forest in front of you, otherwise, you will definitely die!!"
"Quick!!"
Hearing such an urging and worried voice, Qin Feng originally had a lot of things to ask, but he forgot them all for a while, and then the words Grandpa Long Ye said before he died came back.
Immediately, Qin Feng stood up, wiped the dried blood from the corner of his mouth, and while running ahead, he murmured: "Yes, I can't die, I'm going to die, Grandpa Long Ye will definitely blame me!!"
"For Grandpa Tatsuno, I must live!"
"I still have the Nine Dragons Supreme Technique that I haven't practiced yet, and I still have the Nine Dragons Supreme Cauldron that I haven't used!!"
"I can definitely become stronger, definitely!!"
"I want revenge!!"
"I want to live!!"
"I want to make the Long Family of Dragon City disappear into ashes!!!"
"Ah!!!"
With the support of anger, Qin Feng burst out the potential in his body and once again used the movement technique "Wandering Dragon", disappearing from the place at a very fast speed and entering the Ai Mountain.
It didn't take long.
咻咻咻~
The figures of monks descended from the sky and landed where Qin Feng was just now.
Looking at the blood stains left in front of him and the crater made by Qin Feng's fist, Long Zhan frowned and said, "How can this kid still have such physical strength? Did the clan leader's previous Dragon Elephant Fist power really not cause much harm to him?"
